context_assumptions.situation_domain: Beta assumption: es ranges over a fixed nonempty domain of relevant situations. No contextual domain selection or world/tense reasoning is computed.

interpretation_notes: Beta Classical conditional grammar after Gregoromichelaki (2011), §§8.4.1–8.4.3: explicit situation argument, LINK restrictor, shared tau term, and choice evaluation during composition.
One if-clause before or after the matrix clause; named subjects/objects and the listed verbs. An initial antecedent may be followed by a comma or then, or neither.

Fixed-position route only. Unfixed attachment, embedded clauses, pronouns, quantified NPs, temporal/causal clauses, tense, modality and speech-act conditionals are pending. Constructive and TTR adaptations are not included.
